description: US volcano alert levels — USGS volcano alert status for the ~170 US volcanoes. With no parameters: every volcano currently at an elevated alert (ADVISORY, WATCH or WARNING) with its aviation color code, region, threat ranking, elevation and latest notice link. place= or lat=&lon= (+ radius_miles=, default 500): nearest volcanoes with distance, alert status and a verdict (ELEVATED NEARBY / NO ELEVATED VOLCANOES NEARBY / NO US VOLCANOES WITHIN RADIUS). name= looks a volcano up (Rainier, Kilauea, Yellowstone). Optional limit=. Public-domain USGS HANS data, cached 10 minutes. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: geo_volcanoes
